correctness.rationale: All coefficient equations follow from direct Coxeter-word multiplication; odd minimal indices lead to a regular triangular solution with exactly one eliminated coordinate per degree, even minimal indices are excluded by a nonzero square, and the final longest-word relation is handled separately in all parities and characteristics. This proves strata, counts, dimensions, and components. The explicit characteristic-two degeneration absorbs the low-dimensional central stratum when d is even. Independent word-multiplication enumeration passes 15 field/length configurations; finite tests corroborate but do not replace proof.

An all-length geometric classification, exact finite-field point counts and a sharp characteristic-two dimensional jump are natural motivated invariants, not arbitrary finite numerics or textbook substitution. The quadratic character phenomenon for even half-braid length is a genuine arithmetic refinement.
